# Abdullah Tayyab — Ellife Dash

> Portfolio of Abdullah Tayyab (Ellife Dash): Full-stack web developer specializing in MERN stack development, offline-first applications, UI/UX design, and browser automation.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://ellifedash.github.io/): Hero, About, Tech Stack, Projects (Aafiyat, Nankana Home Care), and Contact sections.

## Projects

- **Aafiyat**: Offline-first patient management system for private clinics in Pakistan — SOAP consultations, prescriptions, billing, appointment scheduling, desktop app (Node.js, Express, SQLite, Supabase, Electron, Tailwind CSS).
- **Nankana Home Care**: Three-tier healthcare ecosystem — public brochure site with booking, offline-first PWA (MediAssist Pro) for medical assistants, and secure admin portal with magic-link onboarding (Vanilla JS, Supabase, PWA, GitHub Pages, n8n).
